name: tool-status
description: Names the running tool call on the spinner, with what it is doing under it and its time, and the time since the last call while none runs. Each tool row gets a line naming the call, with +added/-removed lines, its time and any failure; /tool-detail sets how much of every row shows (none, compact, input, full), and clicking a row's line steps that row alone (right or ctrl+click steps back).

requireBashDescription.title: Require Bash descriptions
requireBashDescription.description: Refuse Bash calls that carry no description, asking the model to retry with one
